gloss: final push; last spurt; home stretch

definitions.gloss: final push; last spurt; home stretch
definitions.explanation: The concentrated effort made in the closing stage of a task, a race, or a period of study, when the deadline or finish line is close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}みだ。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧だ。
examples.english: With the final push before the exam, I am short of sleep every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Since the deadline is near, we have decided to make a final push starting this week.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}む→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧ (to drive into, to corner). In this use the sense is not "cornering someone" but rather driving a task toward the finish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}い{込|こ}み: the final push
- {追|お}い{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put on a final push
- {追|お}い{込|こ}み⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: crunch period
- {追|お}い{込|こ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the home stretch

USAGE:
It is used most often of exam study, work deadlines, and the closing laps of a race. In racing it also names a running style in which a horse or runner holds back and overtakes at the end.
